CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a crane-down descending from overhead into a level medium on a 58mm vintage double-gauss, framing with a stacked layered composition with three depth planes.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.
